en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a docked steamship in a harbor. The ship is tied alongside a wooden pier structure on the left, with its bow facing out toward open water that fills most of the right side. Low buildings and a breakwater or pier line the far shore. The lower margin contains bilingual captions in Bulgarian and German identifying the location as the harbor of Varna.
